applicabilityBasis.summary: SMARDEX presents USDN as the yield-seeking vault side of a structured product paired with leveraged long positions. Base USDN itself distributes staking and trader-funding returns by increasing holder balances through rebases. Minting deposits underlying crypto collateral; withdrawal burns the vault units for corresponding underlying-asset value and can be blocked by protocol imbalance. No reviewed source promises an issuer-obligated fixed monetary-value exit or markets USDN as a payment/settlement instrument. This strategy-position nature supports non-payment-token without assuming all synthetic dollars are excluded.

genius.notes: This assessment covers base SMARDEX USDN, not Waves/Neutrino USDN, wUSDN or sUSDN. Primary protocol documents describe a rebasing, yield-generating structured vault position with withdrawals into underlying cryptoassets at vault value and imbalance-dependent access. No securities exclusion, blanket decentralized-issuer exemption or general U.S. legality conclusion is asserted. The reviewed documents do not identify an exact legal issuer or domicile; those optional fields remain omitted. Governance documentation identifies multisig parameter, pause and upgrade powers. The redemption-policy field concerns an issuer-obligated fixed monetary-value policy, not the documented cryptoasset withdrawal mechanism.
